_about: LGIC_LGCTFM round 7 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). THREE cells, cut on 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-6 analysis @ed073a4d48 (msg 98235), which adopted this seat's ranking and made the one decision this seat handed up. Each cell has its OWN record, its OWN arms, and NO arm reads another cell's record.

the_instruction_that_shapes_every_criter.verbatim: AND 'DO NOT PAIR' BINDS THE CRITERION, NOT ONLY THE CELL. S106 is that instruction defeated one level down: two correctly separated cells re-coupled by a shared grading arm that ANDs both.
the_instruction_that_shapes_every_criter.how_this_round_obeys_it: EVERY arm names the ONE cell it grades and reads only that cell's record. The two round-wide arms (vintage, stale proofs) grade THE RECORDS PRESENT IN THIS CHECKOUT -- the S106 repair shape -- so a worker in its own worktree is graded on its own work and nothing else, and the merged tree grades all three because all three are present.
the_instruction_that_shapes_every_criter.and_the_cut_time_bar_it_sits_on: Before a criterion ships, ask: CAN A CORRECT ARTIFACT FROM THIS CELL ALONE SATISFY THIS? Where the honest answer is no, THE CRITERION IS THE DEFECT, NOT THE CELL.

cell_1_the_node_type_population.claim: held -- W2-S2, ARMED and BLOCKING since round 2; the CTO ranked it FIRST
cell_1_the_node_type_population.what_W2_S2_says: every walk emits a COGNITO_USER_POOL row whose node_type sits OUTSIDE org/standards/LGCTFM_CONTRACT.schema.json's 33-value node_type enum, so NO REAL CONTRACT lib/opal_lgctfm.py PRODUCES CAN EVER VALIDATE against its own schema.
cell_1_the_node_type_population.the_cell_is_a_MEASUREMENT_and_decides_no: 1.0.0_SA_CTO, verbatim: 'Cut it as a MEASUREMENT of which node types the engine ACTUALLY emits against the enum's 33, read BY SUBTRACTION from the emitted set, not by checking the ones anybody remembers -- your framing, and it is right. The fork (widen the enum vs refuse at the producer) is decided ON that measurement, not before it.'
cell_1_the_node_type_population.so_the_two_sets_are_both_denominators: EMITTED (what a real run produces) and DECLARED (the enum at HEAD). The cell prints both counts and BOTH DIFFERENCES: emitted-minus-declared (the violation class W2-S2 names) and declared-minus-emitted (enum values nothing emits, which is a different finding and is NOT a defect claim).
cell_1_the_node_type_population.explicitly_admissible_answers: an emitted-minus-declared of exactly ONE (just COGNITO_USER_POOL) is as acceptable as a large set, and so is ZERO if the enum has moved since round 2. The arm refuses a record with no printed denominator on either side, not a record with a small answer.

cell_2_the_gate_scope.claim: held -- W2-S1, ARMED and BLOCKING, disarm_owner 1.0.0_SA_CTO; the CTO ranked it SECOND AND SEPARATELY
cell_2_the_gate_scope.what_W2_S1_says: DEC-9's MARK COMMIT AND THE ENGINE'S OWN RUN ARTIFACTS ARE NOT COMMITTABLE AT DEC-12's RUN HOME: .tools/naming-gate.py in ENFORCE mode REFUSES contract.json, plan.json, PLANT.json, PLANT_UNTYPEABLE.json and MARK.json wholesale.
cell_2_the_gate_scope.the_cell_is_a_MEASUREMENT_TOO: it establishes WHICH paths the gate refuses and WHY -- the refusing predicate named at file:line -- and whether the refusal is by FILENAME, by PATH, or by CONTENT. It proposes no gate edit. A gate edit is the CTO's act on this measurement, and the gate is that seat's own artifact.
cell_2_the_gate_scope.the_positive_control_this_cell_owes: a path the gate ADMITS, run through the same invocation, so the refusal is shown to be selective rather than a gate that refuses everything. A refusal with no admitting control cannot tell a scoped guard from a broken one.

cell_3_the_remediation_census_and_route.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO @ed073a4d48 made this call on a question this seat handed up
cell_3_the_remediation_census_and_route.verbatim: A remediation row unmoved for two rounds is indistinguishable from one nobody owns, and S44 is this project's own proof that silence and progress read identically from outside. Cut it as CENSUS-AND-ROUTE -- each row gets a named owner and a next act, or an explicit retirement -- NOT as a fix-them-all cell, which would be nineteen unrelated remedies in one order.

THE_NINETEEN_IS_AN_INHERITED_COUNT_AND_T.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, over REMEDIATION_v1.md at HEAD, denominator printed
THE_NINETEEN_IS_AN_INHERITED_COUNT_AND_T.so: NINETEEN IS REAL UNDER TWO PREDICATES AND TWENTY-THREE IS THE BROADER UNCLOSED SET. The analysis's number is not wrong; it is PREDICATE-DEPENDENT, and a cell that inherits it without saying which predicate produced it is carrying a subset measurement as a population.
THE_NINETEEN_IS_AN_INHERITED_COUNT_AND_T.and_one_premise_of_the_framing_is_ALREAD: 35 of 35 rows carry a non-empty `owner`. So 'each row gets a named owner' is not the gap -- THE GAP IS THE NEXT ACT. The cell is told this so it does not spend the round re-assigning owners that already exist, and so it re-measures rather than trusting this line.
THE_NINETEEN_IS_AN_INHERITED_COUNT_AND_T.what_this_does_NOT_do: it does not narrow the cell's job. The cell writes its population as a SUBTRACTION from its own freshly-printed denominator at its own write time and STATES ITS PREDICATE; this block is a control on the framing, not the answer.

the_new_bar_this_round_carries.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO @ed073a4d48, adopting S43's carrier over this seat's own weaker version
the_new_bar_this_round_carries.verbatim: an order permitting an out-of-repo instrument names where it LANDS (yours) AND its FIXTURES cite the committed measurement each one encodes (the carrier's second line). An instrument whose fixtures cite nothing is UNGRADEABLE EVEN WHEN PRESERVED PERFECTLY -- preservation answers 'are these the bytes that ran', never 'were these the right numbers'.
the_new_bar_this_round_carries.and_its_sibling_from_the_same_analysis: THE RECORD NAMES EVERY SITE THAT DIVERGES from the code it models, and what each divergence ASSUMES. Round 6's instrument copied three sites verbatim and REWROTE a fourth (cf_node_for hardcoding arn_or_path), and the rewritten site is by construction the interesting one -- a fidelity check over the copied sites proves nothing about it.
the_new_bar_this_round_carries.how_this_round_applies_it: every cell here measures the LIVE artifact directly, so no cell needs an out-of-repo instrument. If a cell reaches for one anyway, both halves bind and its order says so.
